subject: EdgeLayer: request for pilot runway increase & strategic credits
messages:
From: Tom Hwang <tom.h@edgelayer.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension and additional credits for EdgeLayer eval

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the onboarding help this week. We ran a larger ingestion test overnight and are hitting the limits of our current window. The team needs another 45 days to validate the multi-tenant routing and we’d like to request an additional $20k in evaluation credits to finish the performance work and an updated SLA review before we move to PO.

This is higher than typical but the results will determine whether we sign for dedicated capacity. Can you confirm if Redwood can approve a one-time extension + credits? If helpful, I can loop in legal for a quick MSA redline.

Best,
Tom
Tom Hwang
Head of Platform
EdgeLayer, Inc.
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Hwang <tom.h@edgelayer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and additional credits for EdgeLayer eval

Tom —

Appreciate the quick note and congrats on getting the ingestion test in. I’m looping in Marissa from Deal Desk to assess how much we can grant as a one-time, nonstandard uplift. Can you share the rough additional token/compute volume so we can size the uplift? If you already sent a redline to legal, please forward — we’ll include that in the review.

I’ll aim to get a response today; if we need exec signoff I’ll escalate.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pilot extension and additional credits for EdgeLayer eval

Sofia / Jordan —

I pulled the current consumption (attached) — EdgeLayer has used ~62% of the existing eval credits but their ingestion spike suggests they could consume an incremental ~18k USD worth of credits to finish validation. Standard policy: up to $12k one-off credits and 30-day extensions can be approved by Deal Desk; anything above requires VP or CRO approval.

Recommended approach: request exec signoff for a one-time $18k credit + 45-day extension conditioned on: (1) PO or LOE within 30 days of approval, and (2) a short case study or written testimonial if they proceed to paid. If leadership prefers lower, we can offer $12k + 30 days immediately.

Attachment: edgelayer_usage_report.csv

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension and additional credits for EdgeLayer eval — exec signoff request

Vivek —

Forwarding thread + usage report. EdgeLayer is asking for a 45-day extension and ~$20k credits; Deal Desk indicates ~18k estimate based on usage. They’re strategic: platform team, strong chance to convert to dedicated capacity if we can get them through the throughput validation.

My recommended ask: approve a one-time $18,000 eval credit + 45-day runway; require PO/LOE within 30 days and a short case study if they convert. This is a one-time exception outside standard PLG caps.

Attachments: edgelayer_usage_report.csv, edgelayer_msa_redline.pdf (they said legal might push a small MSA tweak)

Can you greenlight or propose modifications? If approved I’ll send formal confirmation to Tom and loop legal for the redline.

Thanks,
Sofia
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot extension and additional credits for EdgeLayer eval — exec signoff request

Sofia —

Appreciate the context. EdgeLayer looks like a material strategic opportunity — I approve a one-time exception but with a narrower scope than requested. Approve: $15,000 in eval credits and a 30-day extension only. Conditions: (1) PO or LOE signed within 30 days of this approval; (2) Redwood receives a short testimonial/case note if they convert; (3) marketing cannot use their logo until legal clears the MSA redline.

If EdgeLayer insists on the 45-day window or $18k, bring this back to me with the specific incremental benefit/risk (ARR lift projection) and I’ll revisit.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Hwang <tom.h@edgelayer.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and additional credits for EdgeLayer eval

Tom —

Good news: leadership approved a one-time exception. Redwood will provide $15,000 in additional eval credits and extend the pilot window by 30 days. Conditions: we’ll need a PO or written LOE within 30 days of this approval and a short written testimonial if you move to a paid engagement. Marketing use of your logo requires legal signoff on the MSA redline.

If that works I’ll schedule a short call with legal to walk the MSA redline and get the PO in motion. Thanks for moving quickly on this — looking forward to finishing validation.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
